tei:div.tei:p: (ta)༄༅// bcom ldan 'das yang gsang khros pa yab yum rkyang sgrub kyi sgrub thabs rgyun khyer dngos grub myur stsol bzhugs so// ༄༅// bla ma dam pa rnams la phyag 'tshal lo// bcom ldan 'das pad+ma dbang chen yang gsang khros pa'i sgrub thabs rgyas pa khrag 'thung lha dgu'i dkyil 'khor yongs rdzogs/ 'bring po yab yum rkyang sgrub/ bsdus pa dpa' bo gcig pa dang gsum 'byung ba las 'dir yab yum rkyang sgrub rgyun gyi rnal 'byor nyams su len par 'dod pa'i rten gang zag 'di'i dkyil 'khor du dbang bskur ba legs par thob cing dam tshig dang sdom par ldan pas/ bde ba'i stan la bsam gtan gyi 'dug stangs kyis gnas la/ mdun gyi nam mkhar skyabs yul rnams mngon sum lta bur bzhugs par dmigs te/ bdag dang 'gro ba nam mkha' dang mnyam pa'i sems can thams cad dus 'di nas bzung ste/ ji srid byang chub snying po la mchis kyi bar du/ dpal ldan bla ma dam pa rnams la skyabs su mchi'o// yi dam dkyil 'khor gyi lha tshogs rnams la= /rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das rnams la= /dam pa'i chos rnams la= /'phags pa'i dge 'dun rnams la= /zhes pa nyer gcig tsam dang*/

bai ros/ pad+ma dbang chen dkyil 'khor la// sgo gsum gus pas skyabs su mchi// rang gzhan don ni rab sgrub phyir// byang chub sems ni bskyed par bgyi// pad+ma dbang chen sgom bzlas ni// bdag gis sems can don du bgyi// zhes tshar gsum gyis skyabs 'gro sems bskyed dang*/ bai ros/ sems can thams cad bde dang ldan// sems can sdug bsngal med gyur cig /sems can bde la rtag par gnas// 'gro rnams sangs rgyas thob gyur cig /ces pas tshad med bzhi bsgom/ rang skad cig gis thun mtshams kyi pad+ma dbang chen du gsal bas/ oṃ ram̐ badz+ra kro dha rak+ṣa badz+ra dz+wa la ram̐ tīk+ṣ+ṇa bi shwa dz+wa la ram̐ phaṭa ram̐ ram̐/ ram̐ a/ oṃ ā ha ra ā ha ra hūm̐/ oṃ badz+ra dhū pe hūm̐ sogs thog mtha' 'dra ba la/ puṣ+pe/ ā lo ke/ gan+dhe/ nai wi d+yā/ shab+da/ oṃ sarba pañtsa a mṛ ta hūm̐/ oṃ ma hā ba liṃ ta pū dzi te dzo hūm̐/ oṃ ma hā pad+ma rak+ta hūm̐/ zhes pas phyi nang gsang gsum gyi mchod rdzas rnams byin gyis brlab/ oṃ swa bhā ba bi shud+dhaḥsarba dharmāḥswa bhā ba bi shud+dho3haṃ/ stong pa'i ngang las pam̐ pad+ma maṇ+ḍa la/ sna tshogs pad+ma'i lte bar/ ma sūr+ya maṇ+ḍa la/ nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor/ a tsan+d+ra maṇ+ḍa la/ zla ba'i dkyil 'khor/ ru dra bam̐/ bdud nag pho mo byi chings su bsnol ba'i gdan gyi steng du/ rang gi rnam par shes pas sa bon gyi yig 'bru hrīḥdamar po dang*/ mam̐ sngon por gyur/ s+pha ra ṇa phaṭa/ de las 'od 'phros 'phags pa mchod/ sems can gyi don byas/ de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi gnas gsum nas rdo rje gsum gyi ngo bo yig 'bru gsum las 'od zer dkar dmar mthing gsum spyan drangs/ saṃ ha raṇa hūm̐/ tshur 'dus yig 'bru la thim pas pad+ma dmar po dang bhan+dha khrag gis gang ba'i rnam par gyur/ tiṣ+ṭha badz+ras brtan par byas/ hrīḥbadz+ra kro dha ha ya grī ba hu lu hu lu hūm̐ phaṭa/ pad+ma yongs su gyur pa las/

bdag nyid bcom ldan 'das pad+ma dbang chen sku mdog dmar nag zhal gsum phyag drug zhabs bzhi pa/ rtsa ba'i zhal dmar nag g.yas zhal dkar ba/ g.yon zhal ljang gu/ zhal re re la dmar la zlum pa'i spyan gsum dang ldan pa/ zhal bgrad cing mche ba gtsigs pa/ ljags 'dril ba/ khro gnyer rab tu bsdus pa/ dbu skra kham nag gyen du 'khyil ba/ rtsa zhal gyi spyi bor rta mgo ljang gu/ rngog ma dmar po/ phrum phrum ser po/ zhur dkar po/ rta skad drag po lhang lhang 'tsher ba/ smin ma dang sma ra ag tshom me ltar 'bar ba/ phyag g.yas kyi dang po pad+ma dmar po 'dab ma brgyad pa dang*/ g.yon gyi dang po bhan+dha khrag gis gang ba bsnams pas yum la 'khyud pa/ g.yas gnyis pas lcags kyu/ g.yon gnyis pas rgyu ma'i zhags pa/ g.yas gsum pas tsan+dan gyi be con dang*/ g.yon gsum pas ral gri rab tu 'bar ba 'phyar thabs su 'dzin pa/ thod pa skam po lnga'i dbu brgyan dang*/ tshal bu'i dpung rgyan/ skam po/ rlon pa/ rnyid pa ste thod phreng tshar gsum gyi do shal can/ sku stod la zhing chen gyi g.yang gzhi dang*/ glang chen gyi ko rlon gsol ba/ stag lpags rlon pa'i sham thabs can/ sbrul rigs bzhi dang*/ rin po che'i rgyan gyis brgyan pa/ rak+ta'i thig le/ zhag gi zo ris/ thal chen gyi tshom bu bkod pa/ khams gsum las rnam par rgyal ba'i rdo rje'i khyung gshog sngon pos bar snang khyab pa/ sgeg pa dpa' ba mi sdug pa// dgod dang drag shul 'jigs su rung ba/ snying rje rngam dang zhi ba ste/ gar dgu'i nyams dang ldan pa/ zhabs g.yas gnyis bskums shing*/ g.yon gnyis brkyangs pa'i gyad kyi dor stabs kyis bzhugs pa/ oṃ ma hā kro dhī shwa rī hūm̐ phaṭa/ bhan+dha khrag gang yongs su gyur pa las/ de'i pang na yum chen pad+ma gar gyi dbang phyug ma/ sku mdog mthing nag zhal gcig phyag gnyis ma/ g.yas pas mi snying rlon pa bzung nas yab kyi mgul nas 'khyud pa/ g.yon pas dung chen dmar 'khyil yab kyi zhal du stob pa/

spyan gsum khrag mig tu blta ba/ zhal bgrad cing mche ba gtsigs pa/ ral pa nag po mun ltar 'thibs pas sku rked yan chod non pa/ mi mgo skam po lnga'i dbu rgyan dang*/ rlon pa lnga bcu'i do shal can/ rin po che'i rgyan gyis brgyan pa/ dur khrod kyi chas kyis spras pa/ zhabs g.yas brkyangs shing g.yon bskums pas yab la 'khril ba/ yab yum gnyis ka nyi ma stong las lhag pa'i gzi 'od 'bar ba/ bskal pa'i me lta bu'i ye shes kyi me dpung 'bar ba'i klong na bzhugs pa'o// ye shes pa spyan drang ba ni/ yab kyi thugs ka'i hrīḥlas 'od zer lcags kyu lta bu 'phros pas/ rang bzhin gyi gnas nas bcom ldan 'das pad+ma dbang chen khrag 'thung yab yum la sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa'i tshogs kyis bskor ba oṃ badz+ra sa mā dzaḥs mdun gyi nam mkhar spyan drang*/ oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta mahā pad+me shwa ra sa pa ri wā ra ar+ghaṃ pra tīts+tsha swā hā/ pā d+yaṃ/ puṣ+pe/ dhū pe/ ā lo ke/ kan+dhe/ nai wi d+yā/ shab+da pra tīts+tsha swā hā/ ma hā pañtsa a mṛ ta khā hi/ ma hā rak+ta khā his phyi nang gsang gsum gyis mchod/ dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥs gnyis su med par thim pas dam tshig pa dang ye shes pa dbyer med du gyur par bsam/ oṃ āḥhūm̐/ spyi bor oṃ dkar po/ mgrin par āḥdamar po/ thugs kar hūm̐ sngon po rnams kyis mtshan par gyur/ hūm̐ badz+ra he ru ka a bhi ṣiñtsa hūm̐/ rang gi spyi bor hūm̐ sngon po las badz+ra he ru ka sngon po rdo rje dang dril bu 'dzin pa/ oṃ bud+dha he ru ka a bhi ṣiñtsa oṃ/ mtshog mar oṃ dkar po las bud+dha he ru ka dkar po 'khor lo dang dril bu 'dzin pa/ swā rat+na he ru ka a bhi ṣiñtsa trām̐/ rna ltag g.yas par swā ser po las rat+na he ru ka ser po rin po che dang dril bu 'dzin pa/ ām̐ pad+ma he ru ka a bhi ṣiñtsa hrīḥ ltag par ām̐ dmar po las pad+ma he ru ka dmar po pad+ma dang dril bu 'dzin pa/

hā karma he ru ka a bhi ṣiñtsa āḥ rna ltag g.yon par hā ljang gu las karma he ru ka ljang gu ral gri dang dril bu 'dzin pa/ de lnga ga'ang thod skam gyi khang bu re rer bzhugs pas dbu brgyan par bsam/ de nas sngar ltar sngags tsam gyis phyi mchod dang*/ sngags kyi rjes su ma hā sarba a mṛ ta khā hi/ ma hā rak+ta khā hi/ ma hā ba liṃ ta khā hi/ zhes pas sman raka gtor gsum gyis mchod/ rgyas par rtags bstod dam/ bsdu na/ kun mkhyen mus srad pas mdzad pa/ hrīḥ dmar nag gru gsum dbang gi dkyil 'khor nas// pad+ma nyi zla bdud bsnol gdan steng du// rnam shes gnas gyur pad+ma he ru ka /zhe sdang rnam dag chos dbyings ye shes dang*// rgyud drug nyon mongs zhe sdang 'joms mdzad pa// khro rgyal rta mgrin dpal la phyag 'tshal lo// phyi nang gsang ba'i mchod pa 'di bzhes la// rmad byung rol pa'i dngos grub stsal du gsol// dga' bzhi bde ba chen po'i dkyil 'khor nas// dus gsum rgyal ba thams cad skyed pa'i yum// bde stong zung 'jug thabs dang shes rab rol// dbyings dang ye shes dbyer med khro ba'i sku// rgyud drug las dang nyon mongs 'joms mdzad ma// khro mo gar dbang yum la phyag 'tshal lo// phyi nang gsang ba'i mchod pa 'di bzhes la// rmad byung rol pa'i dngos grub stsal du gsol// zhes pas bstod/ de nas rlung ro bus nas 'og rlung gyen du 'then pas/ rang gi lte ba nas 'od dmar zhing gsal ba sgron me bteg pa lta bu bde ba'i rang bzhin dmar khyug gis byung bas lus kyi nang thams cad mer gyis gang*/ sdig sgrib bag chags dang bcas pa skad cig de nyid la sangs kyis dag 'od dmar po de nyid sna bug gnyis nas phyir sor bzhi tsam thon nas dmar lam me yod pa la sems gtad de rlung phyir thub tshad du mnan/ mi thub pa dang rlung nang du drangs pa dang mnyam du 'od sngar las kyang ches cher gsal bas lus thams cad khyab pas mun khang du sgron me bteg pa ltar/

rang nyid lha'i sku yab yum zhal sbyor spyan gyi dkar nag ma 'dres par me dpung gi dbus na gsal seng nge bzhugs pa/ me long nang gi gzugs brnyan nam/ rmi lam gyi snang ba'am/ chu zla ltar snang la rang bzhin med pa la sems gtad de/ rlung nang du ci thub 'dzin cing*/ sems 'dzin med du 'jog de ltar yang yang bsgoms pas ting nge 'dzin khyad par can rgyud la skye zhing*/ rgyas par lha khrid sems bzung gi shog dril dang*/ bskyed rdzogs zung 'jug gi shog dril/ de'i bogs 'don dug lnga lam slong gi shol dril/ gtum mo drod kyi shog dril sogs bla ma dam pa'i zhal shes kyis brgyan nas nyams khrid du byas pa las rtogs par 'gyur ro// bzlas pa bya bar 'dod pas/ rang gi thugs kar pad+ma dmar po 'dab ma brgyad pa kha gyen du bye ba'i lte bar hrīḥ 'dab ma brgyad la mdun nas brtsams te g.yas skor gyis sngags phreng kha dog dmar nag yig 'bru gyen du langs pas bskor bar bsam/ de rnams las 'od zer dkar dmar 'dres pa nyi ma'i 'od zer ram/ gser gyi ba thag 'dzings pa bzhin bun bun 'phros pas/ lus kyi nang gang bas nad gdon sdig sgrib bag chags dang bcas pa skad cig la sangs dag 'od zer ba spu'i bu ga dang*/ yab yum gyi sbyor mtshams sogs nas phyir 'phros pas/ phyogs bcu'i zhing khams rab 'byams na bzhugs pa'i rtsa brgyud kyi bla ma/ sgrub sde chen po brgyad la sogs pa yi dam zhi khro'i dkyil 'khor gyi lha tshogs dpa' bo dang rnal 'byor ma dam can srung ma'i tshogs dang bcas pa rnams nyer spyod lnga la sogs pa phyi'i mchod pa/ sman raka gtor gsum sogs nang gi mchod pa/ sbyor ba dang sgrol ba sogs gsang ba'i mchod pa/ gnas lugs rang ngo shes pas mchod bya mchod byed dang bral ba de kho na nyid kyi mchod pa rnams kyis mchod cing thugs dam gyi rgyud bskul/ sems can thams cad la 'od zer phog pas sgo gsum gyi sgrib pa sbyangs/

bye brag tu dgra bgegs log par 'dren pa rnams la 'od zer phog pa'i mod la tshar bcad/ thams cad dpal rta mgrin gyi go 'phang la bkod/ 'od zer tshur 'dus de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi sku gsung thugs yon tan phrin las kyi ngo bo 'od zer kha dog sna lnga pa bsam gyis mi khyab pa dang lhan cig tu mtsho la ser chen babs pa bzhin du rang la chem gyis thim pas/ sku gsung thugs yon tan phrin las dang bcas pa'i dngos grub ma lus pa thob par bsams la/ hrīḥ bdag nyid khro rgyal rta mchog dpal// thugs kar pad+ma 'dab brgyad kyi// ge sar la ni snying po hrīḥ /'dab ma brgyad la sngags kyis bskor// 'od 'phros bde gshegs rnams la thim// phyi nang gsang ba'i mchod pa 'bul// sku gsung thugs kyi dngos grub bsdus// sems can sgo gsum sgrib pa sbyangs// rnal 'byor lus ngag yid la thim// zhes pas gsal btab nas rig pa ma yengs pa'i ngar dang bcas pas/ hrīḥbadz+ra kro dha ha ya grī ba hu lu hu lu hūm̐ phaṭa/ ces pa dang*/ yum gyi thugs kar pad+ma'i lte bar ma yig 'dab ma la sngags phreng gis bskor ba las 'od zer spro bsdu gong bzhin byas la/ oṃ ma hā kro dhī shwa rī hūm̐ phaṭa/ ces pa ji ltar rigs pa bzlas pa'i rjes su/ 'dzab bstod ni/ hrīḥ pad+ma rigs kyi khro rgyal mchog /dpal chen pad+ma he ru ka /mi bzad khro rgyal rta mchog dpal// dbang drag stobs chen rngams brjid gtum// sku mdog dmar nag 'gying zhing brjid// dbu gsum rnam thar gsum yang ston// phyag drug rgyud drug rtsad nas gcod// zhabs bzhi 'khor ba'i chos bzhi sgrol// dur khrod chas brgyad sku la rdzogs// rta mgo ljang gu rta skad 'tsher// me dpung 'bar ba'i klong na bzhugs// rngams pa'i nga ro 'brug stong sgrogs// dregs pa pho mo dbang du sdud// dbang chen sku la phyag 'tshal bstod// ces dang*/ 'dzab kyi dngos grub blang ba ni/

hrīḥ khro rgyal dbang chen rta mchog dpal// dpal gyi sku gsung thugs mchog las// mchog gi dngos grub ye shes dbyig /dus 'dir rnal 'byor bdag la stsol// oṃ pad+mān+ta kṛ ta pad+me shwa ra ma hā kro dha ha ya grī ba ma ma trag mo dun+ti hrīṃ hrīṃ hrīṃ dzaḥ zhes pa nyer gcig tsam dang*/ oṃ pad+ma kro dha kā ya wāka tsit+ta sid+dhi a la la hoḥ zhes brjod pas dngos grub thams cad rang bzhin gyis thob cing brtan par bsam/ de ltar nyams su len pa'i tshe bar chad kyi rnam pa ci byung yang sngags kyi ngar btags te tshar gcod pa ni/ rang gi thugs ka'i hrīḥlas khro chung dmar nag khro zhing rngams pa grangs med pa dang*/ mtshon cha rno zhing rtsub pa dang*/ me dpung tsha zhing rtsub pa 'bar ba 'ur sgra dang bcas pa/ nyi zer gyi rngul ltar 'phros pas gdon bgegs log 'dren thams cad skad cig nyid la tshar bcad cing*/ stong gsum gyi pha rol nam mkha'i mthar yud kyis bskrad nas/ sngar gyi spros pa rnams tshur 'dus rang gi mtha' skor du khro bo'i gur khang sngags kyi nga ro 'brug ltar ldir ba/ de'i phyir mtshon cha'i gur khang*/ de'i phyir me dpung gi gur khang gsal btab/ de rnams las me mtshon khro bo'i tshwa tshwa lcags kyi zhun ma 'thor ba ltar phyogs bcur 'phros pas/ gdon bgegs gdug pa can thams cad rtswa sbur mes tshig pa'am/ me stag chu nang shor ba ltar rjes med du song bar bsams la/ oṃ ram̐ badz+ra kro dha rak+ṣa badz+ra dz+wa la ram̐ tīk+ṣ+ṇa bi shwa dz+wa la raṃ phaṭa/ raṃ raṃ zhes mtshams sngags dang*/ oṃ pad+ma shrī he ru ka mahā tsan+d+ra rā ga pā shaṃ ku ru/ pad+mān+ta kṛ ta badz+ra kro dha ha ya grī ba tsan+d+ra rak+ṣa mahā ba la ma me shwa ri/ pad+ma kro dhī hrīḥhrīḥsarba duṣ+ṭāṃ trig nan ha na ha na da ha da ha pa tsa pa tsa tsit+ta rbad nan/ myog thuṃ ril rbad/ hur thuṃ dzaḥ mā ra ya rbad/ s+t+waṃ bha ya nan/ ces pa lcags mkhar spu gri'i sngags shin tu rno zhing gnyan pa dang*/

oṃ pad+ma kro dhī shwa rī badz+ra pā ṇi kī la ya/ ya ma mahā yak+ṣa/ kā la rū pa karma ram̐ ram̐ dz+wa la raṃ hūm̐ phaṭa/ nā ga du tsan+te tsan+te/ mi li mi li hūm̐ phaṭa/ ces pa bde gshegs gcig dril gyi sngags zab mo rnams thun mtshams su brgya rtsa'am nyer gcig yan bzla bar bya'o// thun 'jog khar lhag chad kha skong ba dang*/ byin rlabs brtan pa'i phyir yi ge brgya pa lan gsum bzla/ sngar ltar mchod bstod bya/ ha ya grī ba hrīḥgab/ ba mo dha ya hrīḥgab/ pad+ma bhan+dha hrīḥgab/ tsaṇ+ḍa rak+ṣa hrīḥgab/ ru lu ru lu hūm̐ bh+yo hūm̐/ zhes pas gnas lngar phyag rgya bcas pas lus bsrung*/ thun mtshams su rang dpal gyi thugs ka nas mar me gcig las gnyis mched kyi tshul du thon la spyod lam bya'o// nang du 'jug pa na sngar gyi de la thim par bsam/ nyal ba'i rnal 'byor lta bu'i tshe lha bsdu bar 'dod pas/ khams gsum snod bcud thams cad 'od du zhu nas yab yum gyi bar du thim/ yum yab/ yab hrīḥyig gi bar du bsdus/ hrīḥyig gi gu'i bar bsdus/ de yang nam mkha' la 'ja' yal ba ltar rig stong gi ngang du mnyam par bzhag nas/ oṃ ma hā shū n+ya tā dzñā na badz+ra swa bhā ba āt+ma ko3haṃ/ zhes brjod/ mthar/ dge ba 'di yis bdag sogs sems can rnams// pad+ma rgyal po'i go 'phang mchog thob nas// ma rig ldongs pa'i skye tshogs thams cad la// rol pa'i rta skad phyogs bcur sgrog par shog /ces bsngo ba smon lam bkra shis kyi bar bya'o// mthar ldang bar 'dod pas de'i ngang las rang nyid skad cig gis dpal gyi skur langs par bsams la/ hrīḥbadz+ra kro dha ha ya grī ba hu lu hu lu hūm̐ phaṭa ces brjod/ de lta bu'i tshul gyis gzhi'i bsnyen pa bya bar 'dod pas/ zhag re la thun bzhir bcad nas nyams su blang*/ dus kyi bsnyen pa zla ba drug gam gsum la sogs pa yin la/ grangs ni yab la 'bum phrag bcu bzhi/ yum la de'i phyed/

rtags sam mtshan ma ni/ gsang rgyud las/ sku nyid dngos su mthong ba'am// slob dpon nyi zla mgo la 'chang*// rdzas la me 'bar 'od 'phro zhing*// snang srid me tog pad+mas gang*// sgrub khang g.yo 'gul sgra chen 'byung*// pad+ma'i snying por bdag 'dug dang*// sangs rgyas nyag gcig chos nyan pas// zhes sogs rnams rmi lam nyams snang mngon sum du 'byung ba ni rim bzhin phyi nang gsang gsum gyi rtags su bshad do// 'di nyid shin tu zab cing gsang ba sgrub thag nye ba'i mthar thug pa yin zhing*/ khyad par snyigs ma'i dus su rgyal po dang klu'i gnod pa phal che ba 'byung bas/ de'i gnyen por 'di bas lhag pa med pas nan tan du nyams su blang bar bya'o// gsang sngags snying po ma hā yo ga'i bcud// sgrub sde brgyad kyi zab don pad+ma gsung*// de yi mthar thug yang gsang khros pa zhes// o rgyan mkhan po'i zhal gyi bdud rtsi'i rgyun// 'dar phyar grub dbang brgyud par bcas pa yi// snyan nas snyan du brgyud pa'i byin rlabs kyi// bka' babs las 'ongs yab yum sgrub pa'i thabs// dngos grub myur stsol deng 'dir kho bos sbyar// bcom ldan 'das yang gsang khros pa yab yum rkyang sgrub kyi sgrub thabs rgyun khyer dngos grub myur stsol zhes bya ba 'di ni/ rang gi slob bu blo dman pa dag la phan pa'i bsam pas kun nas bslangs te/ yang gsang khros pa'i rnal 'byor pa pad+ma drag po rtsal gyis mang mkhar thub bstan dge 'phel gyi dgon par sbyar ba'o// ༈ /dpal pad+ma dbang chen yang gsang khros pa yab yum phyag rgya rkyang sgrub kyi rnal 'byor bzhugs so// na mo gu ru ha ya grī bā ya/ dpal pad+ma dbang chen yang gsang khros pa'i phyag rgya rkyang sgrub kyi rnal 'byor zab mo nyams su len par 'dod pas dben pa'i gnas su mchod gtor sogs tshogs par byas te/ skyabs sems ni/ pad+ma dbang chen dkyil 'khor la// sgo gsum gus pas skyabs su mchi// rang gzhan don gnyis rab bsgrub phyir// byang chub sems ni bskyed par bya// pad+ma dbang chen sgom bzlas ni// bdag gis sems can don du bgyid// lan gsum/

rang skad cig gis pad+ma dbang chen zhal gcig phyag gnyis par gsal ba'i thugs ka nas khro bo mtshon cha'i tshogs thogs pa spros te bgegs rnams tshar bcad par gyur/ oṃ raṃ kro dha badz+ra rak+ṣa badz+ra dz+wa la raṃ tīk+ṣ+ṇa bi shwa badz+ra dz+wa la ram̐ phaṭa phaṭa ram̐ ram̐/ oṃ ā ha ra ā ha ra hūm̐/ dhu pe nas/ shab+da'i bar brjod/ oṃ sarba pañtsa a mṛ te hūm̐/ lan gsum gyis mchod rdzas brlab/ swa bhā was sbyang*/ stong pa'i ngang las pam̐ las sna tshogs pad+ma'i lte bar/ ram̐ las nyi ma dang*/ a las zla ba'i dkyil 'khor gyi dbus su bdud nag pho mo byi chings su bsnol ba'i steng du/ rang gi rnam par shes pa yi ge hrīḥdamar po dang*/ ma sngon por gyur/ de las 'od zer 'phros/ 'phags pa mchod/ sems can gyi don byas/ rgyal ba sras bcas kyi sku gsung thugs kyi byin rlabs tshur 'dus/ pad+ma bhan+dhar gyur/ hrīḥbadz+ra kro dha ha ya grī wa hu lu hu lu hūm̐ phaṭa/ pad+ma yongs su gyur pa las bdag nyid bcom ldan 'das pad+ma dbang chen sku mdog dmar nag zhal gsum phyag drug zhabs bzhi pa/ rtsa ba'i zhal dmar nag zhal g.yas dkar ba/ g.yon zhal ljang ba/ zhal re re la dmar la zlum pa'i spyan gsum dang ldan pa/ zhal bgrad cing mche ba bzhi gtsigs pa/ ljags 'dril zhing khro gnyer 'bar ba/ dbu skra kham nag gyen du 'khyil pa'i spyi bor rta mgo ljang gu/ rngog ma dmar po/ phrum phrum ser po/ zhur dkar po/ rta skad drag po lhang lhang 'tsher ba/ smin ma dang sma ra ag tshom me ltar 'bar ba/ phyag g.yas kyi dang po pad+ma 'bar ba 'dab ma brgyad pa dang*/ g.yon gyi dang por bhan+dha khrag gis gang ba bsnams pas yum la 'khyud pa/ g.yas gnyis pas lcags kyu/ g.yon gnyis pas rgyu zhags/ g.yas gsum pas tsan+dan gyi be con/ g.yon gsum pas ral gri rab tu 'bar ba 'phyar stabs su 'dzin pa/ thod pa skam po lnga'i dbu rgyan dang*/ tshal bu'i dbu brgyan/ skam rlon rnyid pa ste thod phreng tshar gsum gyi do shal dang*/

zhing chen dang glang chen ko rlon gyis stod g.yogs pa/ stag lpags rlon pa'i sham thabs gsol zhing*/ sbrul dang rin po che dang rus pas brgyan pa/ khrag zhag thal chen gyi tshom bus spras shing*/ khams gsum las rnam par rgyal ba'i rdo rje'i khyung gshog sngon pos bar snang khyab pa/ sgeg pa dpa' ba mi sdug pa// rgod dang drag shul 'jigs su rung*// snying rje rngams dang zhi ba ste// gar dgu'i nyams dang ldan pa'i zhabs g.yas gnyis bskums shing g.yon gnyis brkyangs pa'i gyad kyi dor thabs su bzhugs pa/ oṃ ma hā kro dhī shwa rī hūm̐ phaṭa/ bhan+dha khrag gang yongs su gyur pa las/ de'i pang na yum pad+ma gar gyi dbang phyug ma sku mdog mthing nag zhal gcig phyag gnyis ma/ g.yas pas mi snying rlon pa bzung nas yab kyi mgul nas 'khyud cing*/ g.yon pas thod pa khrag gis bkang ba yab gyi zhal du stob pa/ spyan gsum phrag mig tu blta ba/ zhal bgrad cing mche ba gtsigs pa/ ral pa nag po mun ltar 'thibs pas sku sked yan chad non pa/ mi mgo skam po lngas dbu brgyan cing*/ rlon pa lnga bcu'i do shal can/ rin po che dang rus pas brgyan pa gzig gi pags pa'i sham thabs gsol ba/ zhabs g.yas brkyangs g.yon bskums pas yab la 'khril ba/ yab yum gnyis ka'ang nyi ma stong las lhag pa'i gzi 'od 'bar ba/ bskal pa'i me ltar 'khrugs pa'i ye shes kyi me dpung rab tu 'bar ba'i klong dkyil na bzhugs pa'i dpral bar oṃ dkar po/ mgrin par āḥdamar po/ thugs ka dang spyi bor hūm̐ sngon po/ mtshogs mar oṃ dkar po/ rna ltag g.yas su sbā ser po/ ltag par ā+oṃ dmar po/ rna ltag g.yon du hā ljang gu/ de rnams sku gsung thugs dang de bzhin gshegs pa rigs lnga'i rang bzhin du gyur/ rang gi thugs ka'i hrīḥlas 'od zer lcags kyu lta bu 'phros pas/ rang bzhin gyi gnas nas bcom ldan 'das pad+ma dbang chen khrag 'thung yab yum la sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa'i tshogs kyis bskor ba mdun gyi nam mkhar oṃ badz+ra sa mā dzaḥ

e/ chos kyi dbyings nas sku bzhengs pa: dbang chen khros pa'i rgyal po bzhengs: dbus kyi ye shes gzhal yas nas: pad+ma dbang chen gshegs su gsol: dga' bzhi bde bzhi'i gzhal yas nas// yum chen khro mo gshegs su gsol// gar gyi dbang phyug gshegs su gsol// phyogs bzhi 'khor lo 'bar ba'i rtsibs steng nas: sprul pa'i khro rgyal bzhi rnams gshegs su gsol: sgo bzhi gnas kyi gzhal yas nas// sgo skyong khro mo bzhi rnams gshegs su gsol// oṃ e h+ye hi bha ga wān ma hā kā ru ṇi ka dṛ sh+ya ho/ sa ma ya s+t+waṃ/ oṃ badz+ra ar+ghaṃ nas/ shab+da.āḥhūm̐ gis phyi mchod dang*/ ma hā pañtsa a mṛ ta khā raṃ khā his bdud rtsi dang*/ ma hā rak+ta la kha raṃ khā his rak+ta dang*/ ma hā ba ling+ta kha raṃ khā his gtor ma rnams 'bul/ zhing khams thams cad dbang drag gzhal yas khang*// phung po khams dang skye mched ye shes lha// sku lnga ye shes lnga yi rang bzhin can// tshad med bzhi dang phrin las rnam bzhir ldan// thugs rje khros pa khro bzhad rngams pa'i zhal// yab yum sprul 'khor bcas la phyag 'tshal bstod// ces bstod/ bzlas pa ni/ rang gi thugs kar pad+ma dmar po 'dab ma brgyad pa kha gyen du bye ba'i lte bar hrīḥ 'dab ma brgyad la mdun nas brtsams te g.yas skor gyis sngags phreng kha dog dmar nag yig 'bru gyen du langs pas bskor ba rnams las 'od zer dkar dmar 'dres pa nyi zer gyi rdul ltar 'phros nas lus kyi nang gang*/ nad gdon sdig sgrib bag chags dang bcas pa dag 'od zer ba spu'i bu ga dang sbyor mtshams nas phyir 'phros pas/ phyogs bcu'i zhing khams rab 'byams na bzhugs pa'i rtsa brgyud kyi bla ma/ sgrub sde brgyad la sogs pa yi dam zhi khro'i lha tshogs/ dpa' bo dang rnal 'byor ma/ dam can srung ma'i tshogs dang bcas pa rnams la phyi nang gsang ba de kho na nyid kyis mchod pas thugs dam gyi rgyud bskul/

sems can thams cad la phog pas sgo gsum gyi sgrib pa sbyangs/ bye brag dgra bgegs log 'dren la phog pa'i mod la tshar bcad/ dpal rta mgrin gyi go 'phang la bkod/ mchod yul rnams kyi sku gsung thugs yon tan phrin las kyi ngo bo 'od zer kha dog sna lnga bsam gyis mi khyab pa mtsho la ser chen babs pa bzhin rang la thim pas/ dngos grub ma lus pa thob par bsams la/ hrīḥbadz+ra kro dha ha ya grī wa hu lu hu lu hūm̐ phaṭa/ ram̐ kro dha rak+ṣa badz+ra dz+wa la ram̐/ tīk+ṣā bi shwa dz+wa la ram̐/ spyi sngags/ oṃ pad+ma shrī he ru ka ma hā tsaṇ+ḍa rā ga pā shaṃ ku ru pad+māta kṛ ta badz+ra kro dha ha ya grī wa tsaṇ+ḍa rak+ṣa ma shā ba la/ ma ma shwa ri/ pad+ma pad+ma kro dha/ hrīḥhrīḥsarba duṣ+ṭān trig nan/ ha na ha na/ pa tsa pa tsa/ tsit+ta rbad nan myogs thuṃ ril rbad/ hur thuṃ dza/ mā ra ya rbad/ s+t+waṃ bha ya nan/ lcags mkhar/ oṃ pad+ma kro dhī shwa ri badz+ra pā ṇi kī la ya/ ya ma ma hā yak+ṣa kā la rū pa/ karma ram̐ ram̐ dz+wa la ram̐ hūm̐ phaṭ/ nā ga du tsan+dhe tsan+dhe mi li mi li hūm̐ phaṭa/ dbyangs gsal rten snying dang yi ge brgya pas lhag chad kha bskang*/ ha ya grī ba hri gab/ ba mo dha ya hri gab/ pad+ma bhan+dha hri gab/ tsaṇ+ḍa rak+ṣa hri gab/ ru lu ru lu hūm̐ bh+yo hūm̐/ zhes pa'i sngags kyis bsrung zhing bsngo smon shis brjod sogs rgyas par bya'o// zhes pa'ang gsung rgyun ltar dag par bris pa dge/ ༈ /dpal pad+ma dbang chen yang gsang khros pa'i byin rlabs gtor ma'i dbang bskur dngos grub kun stsol ces bya ba bzhugs so// dpal ldan pad+ma gar gyi dbang*// khyab bdag bla ma la btud nas// byin rlabs gtor ma'i dbang bskur ba// dngos grub kun stsol 'bri bar bya// 'di la gsum/ sbyor ba/ dngos gzhi/ rjes so// dang po ni/ stegs bu'i khar/ mañdzi'i steng du dpal gtor pad 'dab bzhi pa mtshams theb kyu dang ril bus bskor ba rgyan spros gang mdzes dang rta mgos mtshan pa'i rtser sku rten tsakli gtor gdugs dmar po rngams brjid dang ldan par bshams pa'i mdun du mchod gtor 'khor rang 'dra brgyad kyis bskor ba/

de'i mdun du bka' srung gi gtor ma/ sman rag phyi mchod sogs legs par bshams/ dkyil 'khor gyi byang shar du las bum bkod/ las byang rgyas bsdus ji ltar rigs pa'i gzhung bsrangs nas/ bdag mdun dbyer med kyi bskyed bzlas dang*/ las bum du skad cig gis hrīḥlas khro rgyal rta mgrin dmar po g.yas tsan+dan gyi be con nam mkhar 'phyar zhing*/ g.yon sdigs mdzub thugs kar mdzad pa/ khro bo'i rgyan dang rnam 'gyur thams cad yongs su rdzogs par gsal ba'i sku las rdo rje bdud rtsi'i rgyun babs pas bum pa gang bar gyur/ rtsa sngags ci nus bzla/ mthar mchod bstod/ chos srung gi gtor bsngo/ tshogs 'khor sogs grub nas/ gnyis pa dngos gzhi ni/ slob ma rnams gral la 'khod/ gzhi bdag spyi gtor btang*/ khrus bya/ bgegs phral/ srung 'khor bsgom pa rnams spyi ltar grub rjes/ 'o nam mkha' dang mnyam pa'i sems can thams cad kyi don du bla na med pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas kyi go 'phang rin po che thob par bya ba dang*/ gnas skabs su'ang 'gal rkyen bar du gcod pa thams cad zhi ba'i slad du byin rlabs dbang bskur gyi rim pa zab mo gsan nas don tshul bzhin du nyams su blang bar bgyi'o snyam pa byang chub kyi mchog tu thugs bskyed pa dang*/ chos gsan pa'i kun tu spyod pa rnams kyang legs par gsal btab ste gsan 'tshal/ de la 'dir gang gsan par bya ba'i chos ni/ rgyu pha rol tu phyin pa'i theg pa las khyad chos du ma'i sgo nas khyad par du 'phags pa'i 'bras bu gsang sngags rdo rje theg pa la'ang gsar rnying gi lugs srol mang du yod pa las/ da lam 'dir snga 'gyur rnying ma'i phyogs yin/ de la'ang rgyud sde dang*/ sgrub sde gnyis su yod pa las sgrub sde yin/ sgrub sde la'ang 'jig rten dang 'jig rten las 'das pa'i bka' rnam pa brgyad du yod pa las/ sangs rgyas thams cad kyi gsung rdo rje rnam pa thams cad pa ye shes sgyu ma'i gzugs su shar ba bcom ldan 'das pad+ma dbang chen gyi skor yin cing*/

de la'ang bka' gter dag snang gi brgyud tshul tha dad pa las/ 'dir ni gter ston sum tshogs kyis yer pa se ba lung nas spyan drangs pa'i nye brgyud gter ma dang*/ slob dpon rin po che pad+ma 'byung gnas kyis dpal ldan grub thob 'dar 'phyar ba rin chen bzang po la dngos su gnang ba'i zab mo dag snang gi chos skor gnyis zung du 'brel zhing*/ lam 'di la mkhas shing dngos grub brnyes pa'i rig 'dzin rtsal 'chang gi brgyud pa bar ma chad par byon pa/ bcom ldan 'das dpal pad+ma dbang chen yang gsang khros pa lha dgu'i byin rlabs gtor ma'i dbang bskur zab mo sgrub par byed pa la'ang*/ slob dpon gyi bgyi bar 'os pa rnams sngon du grub zin nas/ slob ma rnams kyi ngo skal du gyur pa las/ thog mar bla ma dang dpal pad+ma dbang chen tha mi dad pa la dbang bskur zab mo zhu ba'i yon du maṇ+ḍal zhig phul mdzod/ de nas phyag snyim pa me tog dang bcas pas thal mo sbyar te gsol ba 'debs pa 'di'i rjes zlos lan gsum mdzod/ pad+ma sems gtso khyod la 'dud: thar lam chen po bdag 'dod na: de nyid dbang dang dngos grub stsol: mgon po dpa' bor skyabs gsol gyi: theg chen khang par gzhug pa dang : mkhyen rab ye shes bdag la stsol: rgyud dag par bya ba'i slad du/ mdun gyi nam mkhar bla ma dang gnyis su med pa'i bcom ldan 'das pad+ma dbang chen gyi dkyil 'khor la phyogs bcu'i dus bzhi'i rtsa gsum rgyal ba rab 'byams kyis bskor ba'i spyan sngar phyag 'tshal zhing skyabs su 'gro ba dang*/ mchod pa 'bul zhing sdig pa bshags pa dang*/ rjes su yi rangs shing don dam byang sems bskyed pa dang*/ lus 'bul zhing yongs su bsngo ba ste yan lag brgyad kyi sgo nas tshogs bsag par bgyi'o snyam pa'i yid kyis 'di'i rjes zlos lan gsum mdzod/ rdo rje slob dpon sangs rgyas dpal: sogs/ byin dbab pa'i slad du thugs dmigs 'di bzhin mdzod/

gtor ma 'di phyi gtor ma'i rnam pa la nang dbang chen gyi gzhal yas khang gru bzhi sgo bzhi dur khrod rdo rwa me ri dang bcas pa mtshan nyid thams cad yongs su rdzogs pa'i nang*/ dbus gru gsum dmar nag zla gam dmar po gsum pa/ de'i phyi rol du thod phreng dkar pos bskor ba/ de'i phyi rol tu 'khor lo rtsibs bzhi pa/ sgo bzhir zla ba'i gdan dang bcas pa'i dbus su pad+ma nyi zla brtsegs pa'i gdan gyi steng du ru dra pho mo/ shar rtsibs la dri za pho mo/ lho rtsibs la grul bum pho mo/ nub rtsibs la klu dbang pho mo/ byang rtsibs su gnod sbyin pho mo'i gdan gyi steng du/ dbus su bcom ldan 'das pad+ma dbang chen sku mdog dmar nag zhal gsum phyag drug zhabs bzhi pa/ rtsa ba'i zhal dmar nag zhal g.yas dkar ba g.yon zhal ljang ba/ zhal re re la dmar la zlum pa'i spyan gsum gsum dang ldan pa/ zhal bgrad cing mche ba bzhi gtsigs pa/ ljags 'dril zhing khro gnyer 'bar ba/ dbu skra kham nag gyen du 'khyil pa'i spyi bor rta mgo ljang gu/ rngog ma dmar po/ phrum phrum ser po/ zhur dkar po/ rta skad drag po lhang lhang 'tsher ba/ smin ma dang sma ra ag tshom me ltar 'bar ba/ phyag g.yas kyi dang po pad+ma 'bar ba 'dab ma brgyad pa dang*/ g.yon gyi dang po bhan+dha khrag gis gang ba bsnams pas yum la 'khyud pa/ g.yas gnyis pas lcags kyu/ g.yon gnyis pas rgyu zhags/ g.yas gsum pas tsan+dan gyi be con/ g.yon gsum pas ral gri rab tu 'bar ba 'phyar stabs su 'dzin pa dang*/ thod pa skam po lnga'i dbu rgyan dang*/ tshal bu'i dpung rgyan/ skam rlon rnyid pa ste thod phreng tshar gsum gyi do shal dang*/ zhing chen dang glang chen ko rlon gyis stod g.yogs pa/ stag lpags rlon pa'i sham thabs gsol zhing*/ sbrul dang rin po che dang rus pas brgyan pa/ khrag zhag thal chen gyi tshom bus spras shing*/ khams gsum las rnam par rgyal ba'i rdo rje'i khyung gshog sngon pos bar snang khyab pa/

sgeg pa dpa' ba mi sdug pa// rgod dang drag shul 'jigs su rung*// snying rje rngams dang bzhi ba ste// gar dgu'i nyams dang ldan pa'i zhabs g.yas gnyis bskums shing g.yon gnyis brkyangs pa'i gyad kyi dor thabs su bzhugs pa/ de'i pang na yum pad+ma gar gyi dbang phyug ma sku mdog mthing nag zhal gcig phyag gnyis ma/ g.yas pas mi snying rlon pa bzung nas yab kyi mgul nas 'khyud cing*/ g.yon pa thod pa khrag gis bkang ba yab kyi zhal du stob pa/ spyan gsum phrag mig tu blta ba/ zhal bgrad cing mche ba gtsigs pa/ ral pa nag po mun ltar 'thibs pas sku sked yan chad non pa/ mi mgo skam po lngas dbu brgyan cing*/ rlon pa lnga bcu'i do shal can/ rin po che dang rus pas brgyan pa/ gzig gi pags pa'i sham thabs gsol ba/ zhabs g.yas brkyangs g.yon bskums pas yab la 'khril ba/ yab yum gnyis ka'ang nyi ma stong las lhag pa'i gzi 'od 'bar ba/ bskal pa'i me ltar 'khrugs pa'i ye shes kyi me dpung rab tu 'bar ba'i klong dkyil na bzhugs pa/ shar rtsibs la rdo rje dbang chen dkar po/ lho rtsibs la rin chen dbang chen ser po/ nub rtsibs la pad+ma dbang chen dmar po/ byang rtsibs su phrin las dbang chen ljang gu/ de thams cad kyang zhal gcig phyag gnyis pa/ phyag g.yas pa rnams kyis rdo rje/ rin po che/ pad+ma/ ral gri/ g.yon pa rnams kyis dbyug to lcags kyu zhags pa kha ṭ+wām̐ rtse gsum 'dzin pa/ dpal chen gyi chas brgyad dang ldan pa/ ye shes kyi me 'bar ba'i dbus na bzhugs pa/ shar sgor lcags kyu ma dkar mo/ lho sgor zhags pa ma ser mo/ nub sgor lcags sgrog ma dmar mo/ byang sgor dril bu ma ljang gu/ de thams cad kyang phyag g.yas lcags kyu/ zhags pa/ lcags sgrog dril bu dang*/ g.yon thams cad mi'i tsit+ta thogs pa/ zhabs gnyis 'gying stabs kyis me 'bar ba'i dbus na bzhugs pa'i dbu gtsug tu brgyud pa'i bla ma rnams kyang bzhugs pa'i gnas gsum yig 'bru gsum las 'od zer 'phros pas rang bzhin gyi gnas nas bcom ldan 'das pad+ma dbang chen yab yum la sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpas bskor ba dpag tu med pa spyan drangs/

mdun bskyed dang khyed rang rnams la sib sib thim pas lha sngags chos sku'i ye shes kyi rgyud byin gyis brlabs pa'i thugs mos mdzod/ e/ chos kyi dbyings nas sku bzhengs pa: dbang chen khros pa'i rgyal po bzhengs: dbus kyi ye shes gzhal yas nas: pad+ma dbang chen gshegs su gsol: dga' bzhi bde bzhi'i gzhal yas nas: yum chen khro mo gshegs su gsol: gar gyi dbang phyug gshegs su gsol: phyogs bzhi 'khor lo 'bar ba'i rtsibs steng nas: sprul pa'i khro rgyal bzhi rnams gshegs su gsol: sgo bzhi gnas kyi gzhal yas nas: sgo skyong khro mo bzhi rnams gshegs su gsol: oṃ e h+ye hi bha ga wān ma hā kā ru ṇi ka dṛ sh+ya hoḥ sa ma ya s+t+waṃ/ oṃ badz+ra ar+ghaṃ nas/ shab+da āḥhūm̐ gis phyi mchod dang*/ ma hā pañtsa a mṛ ta kha raṃ khā his bdud rtsi dang*/ ma hā rak+ta kha raṃ khā his rak+ta dang*/ ma hā ba ling+ta kha raṃ khā his gtor ma rnams 'bul/ zhing khams thams cad dbang drag gzhal yas khang*// phung po khams dang skye mched ye shes lha// sku lnga ye shes lnga yi rang bzhin can// tshad med bzhi dang phrin las rnam bzhir ldan// thugs rje khros pa khro bzhad rngams pa'i zhal// yab yum gtso 'khor bcu la phyag 'tshal bstod// ces bstod/ de nas dngos gzhi byin rlabs gtor ma'i dbang bskur zhu ba'i slad du gsol ba 'debs pa 'di'i rjes zlos lan gsum mdzod/ khro rgyal rngams chen rta mchog dpal: dpal gyi sku gsung thugs mchog las: mchog gi dngos grub ye shes dbyig: dus 'dir skal ldan bdag la stsol: zhes gsol ba btab nas thugs dmigs 'di bzhin mdzod/ gtor ma lhar gsal ba khyed rang rnams kyi spyi bor spyan drangs shing byin gyis brlabs pa la brten nas/ sku dges pa'i gar mdzad/ gsung sngags kyi rang sgra sgrog thugs mkhyen brtse nus pa'i ye shes bsam gyis mi khyab pas 'od zer kha dog sna tshogs 'phros/

khyed rang rnams kyi lus sems la zhugs pas rkyen phyi nang gi bar du gcod pa thams cad zhi zhing*/ tshe bsod dpal 'byor ye shes thams cad gong nas gong du 'phel zhing rgyas par mdzod/ mthar thug ye shes lha yi sku gsung thugs yon tan phrin las mi zad pa rgyan gyi 'khor lo dang dbyer med par byin gyis brlabs pa yin snyam du thugs mos brtan po gnang bar zhu/ hrīḥ rmad du byung ba dpal gyi gtor ma 'di: ḍā ki chos skyong dam can mchod pa'i phyir: skal ldan slob ma rigs kyi bu khyod la: rmad byung mchod pa gtor ma'i dbang bskur bas: dam can 'du zhing mthu rtsal ldan par shog: gtor ma spyi bor bzhag la/ ma hā ba liṃ ta hūm̐ khā hi a bhi ṣiñtsa hūm̐/ chos sku snang ba mtha' yas/ longs sku pad+ma dbang chen/ sprul sku mtsho skyes rdo rje/ dpal ldan grub thob 'dar 'phyar/ bo dong pa brtson 'grus rdo rje/ nyan chen bsod nams brtan pa/ mkhan chen chos rgyal dpal bzang*/ kun mkhyen dpal ldan seng ge/ chos rje rin chen bkra shis/ rtogs ldan yon tan mgon po/ bla chen chos dpal bzang po/ byams pa rdo rje rgyal mtshan/ mus chen rnam rgyal bzang po/ 'khrul zhig dkon mchog bzang po/ dran chog rat+na badz+ra/ mus chen dkon mchog dpal bzang*/ 'khrul zhig dkon mchog bzang po/ sngags 'chang phyag na rdo rje/ bla ma gu ru rin chen/ 'dar nag rgyal sras bde ba bzang po/ 'jam dbyangs kun mkhyen phrin las/ dbang chen bstan 'dzin dar rgyas/ rig 'dzin ngag dbang phrin las/ 'dar ston ngag dbang 'jigs bral/ 'dar ston pad+ma bdud 'dul/ bdag cag gi dpal ldan bla ma dam pa khyab bdag pad+ma dbang chen blo bzang bstan pa'i nyi ma'i bar du byon pa'i rtsa ba dang brgyud par bcas pa'i rig 'dzin bla ma dam pa rnams dang*/ yi dam dkyil 'khor gyi lha tshogs/ gnas gsum gyi dpa' bo mkha' 'gro/ chos srung dregs byed rgya mtsho'i tshogs dang bcas pa rnams kyis rdo rje'i slob ma 'di rnams la byang chub ma thob kyi bar du bsrung ba dang*/

bskyab pa dang*/ sba ba dang*/ byin gyis brlab par mdzad du gsol/ 'di rnams la steng gdon gza' dang rgyu skar/ 'og gdon klu gnyan sa bdag bar gdon rgyal btsan 'byung po'i gnod pa la sogs pa gdon bgegs kyi gnod pa thams cad srung ba dang*/ zhi ba dang*/ tshar bcad par mdzad du gsol/ gzhan yang nad gdon bar chad mi mthun pa'i phyogs thams cad zhi zhing srung ba dang*/ mthun rkyen srid zhi'i dge legs thams cad gong nas gong du 'phel zhing rgyas te/ mthar thug tshe 'di nyid la dpal pad+ma dbang chen rta mchog rol pa'i go 'phang thob par byin gyis brlab tu gsol/ lha sngags brjod la gtor ma gnas gsum du bzhag cing*/ kā ya sid+dhi oṃ/ wāka sid+dhi āḥ tsit+ta sid+dhi hūm̐/ zhes brjod/ de ltar byin gyis brlabs pas khyed rang rnams dpal dbang chen yang gsang khros pa'i skur gyur pa'i mos pa mdzod/ de nas bzlas lung gi slad du/ thog mar mdun bskyed kyi lha la gsol ba 'debs pa ni slob dpon gyis bgyi bar gda' ste/ mgon po 'di la stsal lags kyis// 'di la 'go bar mdzad du gsol// lan gsum/ slar yang khyed rang rnams kyis gsol ba 'debs pa 'di'i rjes zlos lan gsum mdzod/ mgon po bdag la stsal lags kyis// bdag la 'go bar mdzad du gsol// zhes gsol ba btab pas mdun bskyed yi dam gyi thugs ka'i sngags phreng las sngags phreng gnyis pa zhig chad/ zhal nas thon/ khyed rang rnams kyi zhal du zhugs/ thugs ka'i sa bon gyi mthar 'khod pa'i mos pa dang bcas te sngags 'di'i rjes zlos lan gsum mdzod/ snying po lan gsum/ rkyen sel tsam la bzlas lung 'di ma byas kyang rung*/ mthar gtor ma'i lha tshogs 'od du mer gyis zhu/ khyed rang rnams kyi spyi bo nas mar sib kyis zhugs pas/ snying pad+ma 'dab brgyad kyi steng na yod pa'i sa bon sngags phreng dang bcas pa la thim/ de las 'od zer 'phros pas lus thams cad 'od dmar pos khengs/

ba spu'i bu ga tshun chad rdo rje'i go khrab bzhu blugs su gtams pas phyin chad nad gdon nyer 'tshe gang gis kyang glags mi rnyed par bsrung bar byas pa'i mos pa mdzod/ oṃ badz+ra rak+ṣa rak+ṣa swā hā/ zhes brjod cing gtor ma spyi bor bzhag shis pa brjod/ rjes dam tshig khas blang ba ni/ des gtor dbang zab mo legs par gsan pa yin pas/ dam tshig dang sdom pa la srung sdom tshul bzhin du bgyi'o snyam pas 'di'i rjes zlos lan gsum mdzod/ gtso bos ji ltar sogs/ dbang bskur yongs su rdzogs par thob pa'i gtang rag gi yon du maṇ+ḍal zhig 'bul bar zhu/ slar yang lus longs spyod dang bcas pa 'bul na cha shas nas spyad du gsol snyam pas 'di'i rjes zlos lan gsum mdzod/ deng nas brtsams te sogs/ de ltar na de rnams kyi sgo nas dpal dbang chen yang gsang khros pa'i byin rlabs gtor ma'i dbang bskur legs par gsan pa yin pas/ de las byung ba'i dge tshogs sems can gyi don du bsngo ba lhan cig tu mdzad par zhu/ bsod nams 'di yis sogs brjod la slob ma rnams rang gnas su gtong*/ rjes chog las byang gi dkyus bzhin bya'o// yang nad pa sogs kyi don du brgya tshar byed na/ thog mar bzlas lung gi bar sngar bzhin tshar gcig gi rjes/ slar yang thugs dmigs 'di bzhin du mdzod/ gtor ma 'di nyid dpal pad+ma dbang chen yang gsang khros pa lha dgu'i dkyil 'khor la/ rtsa gsum chos srung rgya mtshos bskor ba khyed rang rnams kyi spyi bor spyan drangs/ sogs gong bzhin la/ chos sku snang ba mtha' yas/ longs sku pad+ma dbang chen/ sprul sku mtsho skyes rdo rje/ dpal ldan grub thob 'dar 'phyar nas/ bdag cag gi bla ma dam pa'i bar du byon pa'i rtsa ba dang brgyud par bcas pa'i bla ma yi dam mkha' 'gro chos skyong srung ma'i tshogs dang bcas pas rdo rje'i slob ma 'di rnams kyi byang chub ma thob bar du 'gal rkyen phyi nang gi bar du gcod pa thams cad zhi ba dang*/

mthun rkyen mchog dang thun mong gi dngos grub ma lus pa thob par byin gyis brlab tu gsol/ rtsa sngags kyi mthar/ kā ya sid+dhi sogs brjod/ spro na bkra shis tshigs bcad re bya/ mthar bzlas lung sogs gong bzhin bya/ gsum pa rjes ni/ bdag bskyed la mchod bstod nongs bshags go cha bgo ba bsngo smon shis brjod sogs spyi ltar bya'o// zhes pa'ang 'dar ston pad+ma dbang chen gyi zhal snga nas tshul 'di'i bka' drin nos pa'i skabs/ 'dar 'phyar ba pad+ma bdud 'dul gyis mdzad pa'i gtor dbang gi cho ga las nyung gsal snying por dril ba'i tshul gyis dben pa'i sgrub gnas bsam gtan gyi sbugs su zin bris te btab pa dge legs mchog tu gyur cig/ // ༈ bal yul mchod rten rin po che bya rung kha shor gyi nye 'gram rgyal yongs sa chen zhes pa glog klad dpar khang las/ bder gshegs 7skyabs rje bco brgyad khri chen rdo rje 'chang mchog gi thugs dgongs rdzogs ched/ skyabs 'og pa tshar grwa gu rus glog klad phyag deb ched 'grem spel zhus pa'i dge 'bras sangs rgyas zhing du bsngo'o// //
